attributes.name: f_0091
attributes.description: Curated daily revenue metrics for reporting. Trusted business-facing mart used by finance dashboards and quarterly board packs.
attributes.userDescription: Gold-certified revenue rollups. No raw payment grain; preferred for executive reporting.

attributes.name: stg_amt
attributes.description: Payment-level facts used to calculate revenue. Staging layer with one row per payment attempt.
attributes.userDescription: Lower-level detail feeding revenue marts. Not certified for reporting.

attributes.name: gx_117
attributes.description: Attrition and churn-risk scoring for retail customers. Models why customers stop buying or engaging.
attributes.userDescription: Table hosts churn_propensity column for disengagement scoring and retention campaigns.

attributes.name: cust_scr_ds
attributes.description: Customer lifetime value metrics and value bands for retail accounts.
attributes.userDescription: Table hosts v_band column grouping customers by long-term relationship value.

attributes.name: cmp_9
attributes.description: Campaign definitions and multi-touch attribution metadata.
attributes.userDescription: Source for campaign spend and response joins used in marketing ROI analysis.

attributes.name: rev_roll
attributes.description: Curated marketing performance and return-on-investment metrics by campaign.
attributes.userDescription: Campaign returns and ROI rollups for marketing leadership reviews.

attributes.name: cust_raw
attributes.description: Customer profile source data. Contains personally identifiable email_hash values.
attributes.userDescription: Direct source of personal customer contact data. Requires privacy controls.

attributes.name: seg_out
attributes.description: Downstream segmentation output produced by proc.cust_segmentation from raw.cust_raw.
attributes.userDescription: Customer segment assignments for mart.seg_out. Privacy tags propagate from upstream raw.cust_raw via lineage (not set directly on this table in the seed).

attributes.name: churn_propensity
attributes.description: Column measuring likelihood a retail customer stops buying or engaging.
attributes.userDescription: Churn propensity score column on edw.gx_117. Used when analysts ask why customers stop buying.

attributes.name: v_band
attributes.description: Customer value band column encoding lifetime relationship worth.
attributes.userDescription: v_band column on edw.cust_scr_ds. Synonym-friendly for customer worth and CLV banding.

attributes.name: email_hash
attributes.description: Hashed customer email column containing personal contact data.
attributes.userDescription: email_hash column on raw.cust_raw. Direct source of personal customer email data for privacy controls.

attributes.name: ord_fct_2
attributes.description: Orders fact table and authoritative system of record for order transactions.
attributes.userDescription: Canonical orders dataset for finance and operations. Governed as source of truth.
